title: Univariate Continuous Feature Profiling
description: Comprehensive statistical and distributional profiling of continuous numerical variables.
conditions: Initial exploration phase of raw or cleaned tabular dataset
Requirement to identify skewness, multimodal distributions, and zero-inflation
Data validation prior to statistical hypothesis testing
recommended_methods: Five-number summary (Min, Q1, Median, Q3, Max) plus Mean and Standard Deviation
Fisher-Pearson skewness coefficient and kurtosis calculation
Kernel Density Estimation (KDE) and Freedman-Diaconis histogram inspection
selection_rules: If skewness > 1.5, classify feature as heavily right-skewed and evaluate log/box-cox transform
If multimodal distribution detected in KDE, explore underlying subgroup mixture components
If > 30% of non-null values are exactly zero, profile separately as zero-inflated continuous feature
limitations: Skewness and kurtosis are hyper-sensitive to sample size and lone outliers
KDE bandwidth selection can smooth out genuine narrow multimodal peaks if bandwidth is too large
